summary: This script snippet defines three environment variables that store Git configuration information, likely to be used inside a Docker container. These variables capture the user's email, full name, and username so they can be automatically configured when Git is initialized in the container.

explanations.1: This creates a variable named DOCKER_GIT_USEREMAIL and assigns it the email address string. It will be used to set the Git user email configuration inside Docker.
explanations.2: This creates a variable named DOCKER_GIT_FULLNAME and assigns it a full name string. It will be used to set the Git user name configuration inside Docker.
explanations.3: This creates a variable named DOCKER_GIT_USERNAME and assigns it a username string. It will be used to set the Git username configuration inside Docker.
